text:
[Council File 21-1230-S6]
Statutory Exemption from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to the California Public Resources Code Section 21080.085(a); and find that the Project was assessed in the Housing Element
Environmental Impact Report (EIR) No. ENV-2020-6762 (State Clearinghouse No. 2021010130), and Addenda 1 and 2 (ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD1 and ENV2020-6762-EIR-ADD2), and related CEQA Findings; report from the Los Angeles City Planning Commission; and proposed Housing Element Sites and Minimum Density Amendment ordinance and Lower Income Sites ordinance, relative to a citywide code amendment in Chapters 1 and 1A of the Los Angeles Municipal Code that will clarify eligibility and review procedures, permit a project to utilize abutting sites, and improve clarity and internal consistency by correcting errors, omissions, and ambiguous language, and the adopting the inventory of Lower Income Rezoning Housing Element Sites (LI Sites), and update the inventory of LI Sites consistent with current eligibility and site standards to ensure continued compliance with state law requirements; and adoption of project findings.
Applicant: City of Los Angeles
Case No. CPC-2026-4893-CA
Environmental Nos. ENV-2026-4894-SE, ENV-2020-6762- EIR, ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD1, ENV-2020-6762-EIR- ADD2
Fiscal Impact Statement:
No
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted

outcome.text: Planning and Land Use Management Committee action: Approved: APPROVED the Los Angeles City Planning Commission Report dated October 29, 2026; and REQUESTED the City Attorney to prepare and present two draft Ordinances (Nov 12, 2026)
